_comment: Allowlist for scripts/check_publish.py. Everything in this file is synthetic by construction. Never add a value here to silence a finding you have not proven synthetic; adding a real value here defeats the entire gate.

publishingIdentities._why: The only git identity allowed to appear in config or history of this repo. The gate fails closed on anything else so a commit can never ship under a personal identity.

allowedEmailDomains._why: Documentation placeholder domains plus GitHub noreply. No real mail domain belongs here.

syntheticTokens._why: Placeholder referral codes and fabricated session tokens used in templates and tests. All invented; none was ever issued by Amex.
